config.reason: Full DEV exposed added false-decode frames in unrestricted native retries. Test format-scoped retry proposals while preserving every baseline read and all native decoder checks. The default ZXing adapter also uses UPC-E and Code39Extended representations different from the benchmark importer.
config.cached_predictions: All 577 frames from completed barcode-v2; freeze source-result and private prediction hashes before computing candidate scores. No extra inference and no per-frame truth-dependent selection.
config.retry_rule: Keep all native baseline decodes. Add only named matrix-format decodes from the specified retry, deduplicate exact format/text. This is an output-only prototype, not a measured format-restricted decoder invocation.
config.zxing_equivalence: Code39Extended -> code39; 13-digit leading-zero UPC-A -> 12 digits; 13-digit leading-zero UPC-E -> 8 digits via pinned import_barcodes_public.py upca_to_upce. Retain HRI strings otherwise; do not repair unknown text or tune to truth.
config.promotion: More exact recovered codes on at least one DEV corpus, no new false-decode frame on either, no lost baseline code. No runtime claim from cached predictions.

config.barcode_merge: union_exact_format_and_text; no oracle gating; every frame retried

decisions.promote: no extra wrong accepts or false decode frames; retain all regressions; no speed claim from accuracy-pass wall times
decisions.id_metric: unchanged public_id/score_id.py exact kind and ten MRZ fields
decisions.temporal: deferred: two widely spaced frames per sequence are insufficient for production capture-policy claims

config.harness_revision: v2: PIL RGB-to-BGR fallback only when OpenCV fails to load pinned input; original aborted attempt and 143 completed private frame records retained
